purpose: Edit an authorized DDN workspace through the exact DDN Designer API while the project asset authority owns versioned persistence.
navigation_model: The DDN source workspace remains authoritative; rendered scene and SVG remain projections.

states.default: Authorized source state is editable through DDN Designer.
states.loading: Asset identity remains visible during library and source restoration.
states.empty: A valid empty workspace offers the registered DDN creation tools.
states.error: Validation/save conflicts retain unsaved source state and report recovery actions.
states.permission: Viewer access forces read-only behavior and suppresses mutation commands.
states.disconnected_or_stale: Save failure/conflict marks persistence state and blocks accidental close until save or discard.

keyboard: DDN public keyboard behavior is preserved; host Save and close policy use registered commands and standard focus handling.
pointer: DDN public pointer/drag behavior owns canvas editing; host owns tab docking and window transfer.
persistence: Exact source snapshot saves through AssetRef with expected version; rendered SVG and scene geometry are never authoritative.
multi_window: Designer is detachable but not duplicable; ownership and optimistic save authority remain stable across windows.
accessibility: Host toolbox, validation and status are labelled; library errors flow to shared diagnostics.
